In fact, except for Applied elasticity, all but three of his many text- books appeared during the years that he was at Michigan. These included: Strength of materials, Vibration problems in engineering, Theory of elasticity, Theory of elastic stability, and an elementary book, Engineering mechanics, written in collaboration with D.
